title: Classify issued SCHC ACK authorities from immutable bytes
description: During correctness review of project-LICHEN-worker6-8j2e, LinkLayer._send_locked checks Ack.from_bytes(payload) while payload is the private _IssuedFragmentWire bytes subclass. Ack.from_bytes intentionally requires exact built-in bytes, so ordinary manager-issued ACK responses (for example C=1 0x7840) are misclassified as data and can bypass the mandatory Priority.ACK gate. Snapshot the issued authority to exact bytes for structural classification before consumption/signing, retain one-use/target binding, and add a non-compressed ACK wrong-priority regression.
